neighboring_unit_entries.title: A zero-free-region contour evaluates polynomial mollifier convolutions uniformly
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Factors a generic mollifier convolution by two reciprocal zeta functions, uses the polynomial's double zero at the endpoint, shifts within a zeta zero-free region, and expresses the result as a local residue plus exponentially decaying error.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Derivative data of the taper controls the long gamma contribution
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Applies the convolution residue beyond the breakpoint, expands the local analytic factor, converts the gamma sum to an integral involving Q, Q-prime, and Q-double-prime, and uses contour residues plus integration by parts to obtain the explicit long-range term.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Reorganizing the square-free coefficient pairs exposes a generic convolution lemma; splitting at the taper breakpoint then makes the short range a pole calculation and the long range an integral controlled by the taper's endpoint and derivative conditions.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The source evaluates one constrained polynomial family and explicitly leaves optimal mollifier selection unresolved.
